purpose: The slide-out navigation panel. Present on 4 of the 6 routes; the 404 does not render it.

hidden.note: true reproduces the source's .is-hide class: the link is in the markup but invisible.

groups.note: Exactly 3 labelled groups: Menu (4 in-page anchors, label.emphasis), Other (3 policy links, label.secondary), Social media (3 links in a row, 2 of them .is-hide).

label.note: Measured: the source ships the typo "Ge tstarted" (Menu.jsx:41) where every other instance says "Get started". Preserved verbatim; do not reproduce the typo in NEW copy.

evidence.structure: Structure, layout and motion measured against the live original. A pixel audit verified 1382/1382 elements at a 1440px viewport and 962/962 at 390px with zero deltas. Copy is the original's own.

constraints.verification: src/layout/Layout.jsx:42 renders it behind a `menu` flag that defaults to true; src/pages/NotFound.jsx:7 passes menu={false}. Checked against all 5 real templates: present once and immediately after chrome.header in home / legal / app-onboarding / app-auth, and ABSENT from not-found.

motion.detail: public/motion/m19.js opens the panel over 0.4s power2.out and staggers the list items by 0.05 over 0.3s. Closed geometry 15rem x 2.7rem with translateY(2rem); open 18rem x 39rem. m19.js also carries its own hand-rolled scrambleText().
motion.reducedMotionFallback: Toggle the panel between its closed and open geometry instantly, with every link at full opacity and no stagger.
motion.reducedMotionFallbackKind: design-rule (the source ships NO prefers-reduced-motion handling for this section, so the fallback is prescribed by this repository, not mirrored)

responsive.max-767px: closed 15.5rem wide with translateY 0.5rem instead of 1.25rem (m19.js)

notes: The menu's Social media group lists Instagram / Linkedin / Youtube while chrome.footer's equivalent group lists Instagram / Facebook / Youtube. The two lists genuinely disagree in the source. Both second and third entries carry .is-hide in both places, so neither is visible; the discrepancy is recorded, not reconciled.
contentMaxWordsTotalNote: Set BETWEEN the measured real total and the maximum the per-field budgets allow, so the cap can actually reject an over-long instance instead of being unreachable. extraction/verify_all.py check [p] fails if any declared contentMaxWordsTotal becomes vacuous (>= the per-field maximum).
